title: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: A young half-fae hero who confronts Eriette at Castle Ardenvale and learns from his mother that his father is Oko.

entities.name: Ruby
entities.description: Kellan's friend who wields an ice sword granted by Hylda and fights Eriette.

entities.name: Rowan Kenrith
entities.description: A knight and sorceress who knocks Kellan and Ruby out, fights her brother's army for Eriette, and then blasts the castle and escapes into the sky.

entities.name: Will Kenrith
entities.description: Rowan's twin brother, the High King of Eldraine, who leads an army to Ardenvale and freezes Ashiok.

entities.name: Eriette
entities.description: A witch and Rowan's aunt who controls the sleepers with the Wicked Slumber and is later captured and freed by Ashiok.

entities.name: Ashiok
entities.description: A faceless planeswalker dreamweaver who controls the sleepers expertly, is frozen by Will's bolt, and then rescues Eriette from her cell.

entities.name: Imodane
entities.description: A wooden-armed knight now fighting for Will, who rejoins the battle against Rowan.

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: Kellan's father, a shapeshifting fae-like planeswalker who lamented he couldn't confront Talion, who once loved Kellan's mother and visited her three years ago.

entities.name: Ronald
entities.description: Kellan's stepfather.

entities.name: Hex
entities.description: The family sheepdog who leads Kellan to a portal.

entities.name: Hylda
entities.description: A witch who gave Ruby a sword of eternal ice.

entities.name: Troyan
entities.description: A guide who lent Kellan and Ruby frogification potions.

entities.name: Talion
entities.description: The Faerie Lord whom Kellan asked to let him go home to hear his father's story from his mother.

entities.name: Royse
entities.description: A weaver whose advice about rest Rowan remembers.

entities.name: Hazel
entities.description: A Kenrith sibling whom Will says needs them.

entities.name: Erec
entities.description: A Kenrith sibling whom Will says needs them.

entities.name: Cotter boys
entities.description: Village boys who bully Kellan.

entities.name: Oriq
entities.description: A faction Rowan cites as a threat that diplomacy would not have stopped.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders who killed Rowan and Will's parents.

entities.name: Will's knights
entities.description: The army of knights led by Will to Castle Ardenvale.

entities.name: Sleepers
entities.description: People controlled by the Wicked Slumber who fight for Eriette and Ashiok.

entities.name: The Wicked Slumber
entities.description: The curse of sleeping and dream control spread across the Realm.

entities.name: Castle Ardenvale
entities.description: The ruined royal castle where Eriette holds her throne and the final battle occurs.

entities.name: Orrinshire
entities.description: Kellan's quiet sheep-farming home village.

entities.name: Fae World
entities.description: The fae realm entered via portal outside Ardenvale.

entities.name: Eldraine
entities.description: The fairy tale plane.

entities.name: Basket hilts
entities.description: Kellan's fae hilts that he uses as a whip of golden vine.

entities.name: Ruby's ice sword
entities.description: A giant sword of eternal ice granted to Ruby by Hylda.

entities.name: Oko's portal
entities.description: A swirling portal of interlocking triangles that Hex finds in the woods and Kellan steps through.

events.summary: Kellan and Ruby ride to Castle Ardenvale on ponies and use the second frog potion to jump over its gates.
events.quote: They're in the air seconds later.

events.summary: Inside they find Rowan in the throne room studying curse notes; Kellan reads her note about attempting to put people to sleep before she knocks him out with sparks.
Kellan wakes in a cell, freed by Ruby, who says Rowan knocked them out and was trying to work dream magic on him when Will's army arrived.
Will's knights burst into Ardenvale as Eriette strains to control sleepers and Rowan blasts the floor before Imodane.
events.quote: All of this energy she unleashes in a fearsome bolt aimed at Imodane's feet.

events.summary: Rowan and Will confront each other; he pleads for her to come home but she attacks him with her sword.
Kellan and Ruby attack Eriette's throne while Rowan reveals Eriette is their aunt and begs Will to save her; Will says he doesn't know her anymore.
events.quote: "I don't know you anymore," he says.

events.summary: Ashiok returns and takes control of the sleepers, turning the battle against Will's knights.
events.quote: Veils of black coalesce into Ashiok's elegant form before the gathered army.

events.summary: Kellan lashes Ashiok in place with his golden whip so Will can strike them with a bolt of ice, which makes Ashiok vanish.
events.quote: Ashiok lets out a howl of pain as the ice spreads through their body.

events.summary: Ruby holds her blade to Eriette's throat; Eriette tells Rowan by thread to leave and bide their time.
events.quote: Go from this place, Eriette says to her. When the time is right, we will meet again.

events.summary: Rowan blasts the floor and rises into the air, vowing one day to bring the blessed slumber to all of Eldraine, and escapes.
events.quote: A boom louder than the fall of a giant.

events.summary: Will thanks Kellan and Ruby and invites them to the palace; Kellan slips away to the Fae World.
events.quote: Outside of Castle Ardenvale he steps into the Fae World.

events.summary: Kellan returns home to Orrinshire and is reunited with Hex, Ronald and his mother, who gives him an enchanted coat.
events.quote: yes, after all of that, he is finally home.

events.summary: Kellan's mother tells him about his father, Oko, a shapeshifting being from another Realm she met while training and who wanted to raze the town after it shunned her.
events.quote: He told me his name was Oko

events.summary: Hex leads Kellan to a swirling portal in the woods and Kellan steps through, hoping to find his father.
events.quote: Kellan pets Hex, and steps through the portal.

events.summary: Ashiok frees Eriette from her cell, promising her new land far away, and she vanishes.
events.quote: "Opportunity calls us in a new direction.

relations.quote: No, it isn't. Hazel and Erec need us—

relations.note: Rowan calls Eriette her and Will's aunt

relations.quote: "Awake. All is not yet lost. I have returned for you."
"Honey! Honey, he's home, our boy's home!"
The girl in red is swinging a sword twice her size at Eriette

relations.note: Imodane fights for the High King
relations.quote: He's going to be the one to reunify the Realm.

relations.note: Hylda granted Ruby the boon of a sword of ice with the crown's last magic
relations.quote: With the last bit of the crown's magic she'd granted Ruby the boon
